title: tilia platyphyllos subsp. caucasica
intro: Tilia platyphyllos subsp. caucasica, commonly known as the Caucasian large-leaved linden, is a subspecies of tree native to the Caucasus region and parts of Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Tilia platyphyllos subsp. caucasica are attributed to its ability to exhibit sedative, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
